Identifying RPC handlers that transitively trigger outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs, likely through webhook mechanisms.

Webhook dispatchers such as `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`, and `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` are the primary candidates. They are triggered by memo service handlers and converge at `webhook.Post` or `webhook.PostAsync`. Identity provider OAuth endpoints and HTTP getters for link previews were considered but are less likely to be user-configured URLs.
I'll trace RPC handlers that reach outbound HTTP to a user-configured URL.

I am analyzing which RPC handler methods transitively trigger outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs. I need to identify at least three such handlers and the single convergence function where their paths merge before delivery.

The user-configured URL is the webhook endpoint. RPC handlers such as CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, and DeleteMemo dispatch webhooks. They all converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, which then calls `webhook.PostAsync` to deliver the request.

`webhook.PostAsync` is the single convergence function before delivery. `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` bypasses `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` and calls `PostAsync` directly. I am now listing all RPC handlers that trigger webhooks.

Identified RPC handlers in memo_service.go and memo_service_comments.go. CreateMemo and DeleteMemo reside in memo_service.go. CreateMemoComment resides in memo_service_comments.go. Update logic flows through memo_update_helpers.

Checking additional update paths and batch operations that may route through helpers to DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook.

message.text:
CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, and CreateMemoComment are the RPC handlers that can transitively cause outbound HTTP requests to user-configured webhook URLs.

UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations are additional RPC handlers that trigger outbound HTTP requests. All created, updated, and deleted paths converge before delivery through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`.

The convergence function is `webhook.PostAsync`. It is the single point where all webhook paths enqueue the outbound HTTP request before delivery.

Other candidates were considered but rejected. GetLinkMetadata and BatchGetLinkMetadata fetch URLs from request parameters rather than stored configuration. IDP OAuth uses admin-configured endpoints. DeleteUser was also briefly evaluated.

h06.
`CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo`, `DeleteMemo`, `CreateMemoComment`, `SetMemoAttachments`, `SetMemoRelations`; `PostAsync` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go`

Those handlers dispatch memo webhooks (`DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` / `Updated` / `Deleted` / `CommentCreated` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`; updates also via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go`). All of them call `webhook.PostAsync`, which queues the request before `Post` sends HTTP to the stored webhook URL.
